traits.name: Consume Flesh
traits.text: ⬻ (manipulate); Requirements The ghoul is adjacent to the corpse of a creature that died within the last hour. Effect The ghoul regains 1d6 (1d6) Hit Points. It can regain Hit Points from any given corpse only once.

traits.name: Ghoul Fever
traits.text: Saving Throw DC 15 Fortitude. Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 day) Stage 2 2d6 (2d6) negative damage and regains half as many Hit Points from all healing (1 day) Stage 3 as stage 2 (1 day) Stage 4 2d6 (2d6) negative damage and gains no benefit from healing (1 day) Stage 5 as stage 4 (1 day) Stage 6 dead, and rises as a b1 the next midnight (undefined)

traits.name: Paralysis
traits.text: (incapacitation, occult, necromancy); Any living, non-elf creature hit by a ghoul's attack must succeed at a DC 15 Fortitude save or become paralyzed. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns, and the DC cumulatively decreases by 1 on each such save.

traits.name: Swift Leap
traits.text: ⬻ The ghoul jumps up to half its Speed. This movement doesn't trigger reactions.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ jaws +9 (finesse); Damage 1d6+1 (1d6+1) piercing plus ghoul fever and paralysis

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ claw +9 (agile, finesse); Damage 1d4+1 (1d4+1) slashing plus paralysis
